start_welcome: 👋 Hi! I'm PostModeBot — I'll help you build and format a post for a Telegram channel or group: text, media, buttons — and send it wherever you like.
help_text: ℹ️ How it works 1. Tap “📝 Create a post” 2. Send the post text (HTML formatting is supported) 3. Send a photo/GIF/file or skip this step 4. Add link buttons (optionally with a color dot 🔵🟢🔴) or skip 5. Enter the target channel/group (@username or ID) 6. Check the preview and confirm sending The bot must be added to the channel as an admin with the “Post messages” permission. ⚠️ Telegram doesn't have real colored buttons — “color” is just an emoji dot placed before the button text, for visual clarity. 💰 “Support the author” is a donation via built-in Telegram Stars ⭐, no third-party services needed.
donate_text: 💰 If the bot has been useful, you can support the author with Telegram Stars ⭐ — Telegram's official in-app currency. The payment happens right here, no external sites or cards.
donate_choose_amount: ⭐ Choose a donation amount in Telegram Stars:
donate_invoice_description: A voluntary donation to the bot's author via Telegram Stars. Thanks for the support! ❤️
donate_thanks: 🎉 Thank you! You sent {amount} ⭐. It really helps the bot grow ❤️
post_ask_text: ✍️ Send the text of the post. HTML formatting is supported: bold, italic, links, etc.
post_ask_media: 🖼 Send a photo, GIF or file for the post — or tap “Skip” if you don't need media.
post_ask_buttons: 🔘 Link buttons Send one button per line: Button text - https://link Example: Our channel - https://t.me/example 🎨 Want a color dot before the button text? Add a color as a third field after « - »: Buy - https://example.com - green → 🟢 Learn more - https://example.com - blue → 🔵 Warning - https://example.com - red → 🔴 You can send several lines at once — each becomes a separate button. Or tap “Skip”.
post_buttons_hint: Button text - https://link - blue|green|red (color is optional)
post_ask_target: 🎯 Where should the post be published? Send the @username of the channel/group, a t.me/... link, or a numeric chat ID.
post_target_invalid: ⚠️ Couldn't recognize the target. Send an @username, a t.me/... link, or a numeric ID.
error_chat_not_found:
The chat wasn't found:
• double-check the @username or ID
• private channels need a numeric ID like -100…
• the bot must be a member of that chat
error_forbidden:
The bot isn't allowed to post there:
• add the bot to the channel/group
• for channels, the bot must be an admin with the “Post messages” permission
error_file_too_big: The file is too large to upload via the Bot API. Try a smaller file.
